---
name: 🚀 Feature Request (Main Task)
description: Create a new high-level feature request with clear goals, tasks, and subtask breakdowns.
title: "[Feature] <Title of Feature>"
labels: ["feature"]
assignees: []
---

## 🎯 Goal

_Describe the goal of this feature clearly. What user need or system functionality is being addressed?_

Example:
> Allow users to register and log in securely, with role-based access based on barangay.

---

## 📋 Tasks

_Break the feature into logical components and sub-issues (if known). Use checklists for clarity._

- [ ] Create relevant models and database tables
- [ ] Implement core logic
- [ ] Build UI or forms
- [ ] Link related subtasks
- [ ] Add tests and validations

---

## 🔗 Related Subtasks or Dependencies

_Optional: Add links to sub-issues or required tasks (e.g., #7a, #8, etc.)_

---

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

_What does "done" look like? Use checkboxes to define measurable success._

- [ ] User can perform the action
- [ ] Role or logic restrictions apply
- [ ] Proper validations exist
- [ ] Security requirements met

---

## 🧠 Tips for Writing a Good Feature Issue

- Focus on **why** the feature is needed.
- Break it into **steps/tasks** you or your team can actually complete.
- Link subtasks or child issues if the feature spans multiple parts of the app.
